messages:
marta: Quick sync — small maintenance in eu-west tonight 22:30 UTC. Work: runtime kernel micro-patch + model pin (redwood-v2-medium). Expected window ~22:30-23:15 UTC.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: runtime-eu-kernel-2026-03-28. Canary: 5 nodes (5% traffic). Rollout: canary -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Auto-rollback on 2m sustained 5xx >0.7% or p99 >= baseline*1.5.

sam: Can we get statuspage + email copy now so support can queue it? 20m pre-publish preferred.

marta: Draft statuspage blurb: "Planned maintenance: brief runtime update (kernel patch and model pin) in EU on 2026-03-28 22:30 UTC. Expect most requests to be unaffected; a small number may see short retries. Updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2869994321"

emily: Email snippet: Subject: Planned maintenance — EU inference runtime (Mar 28 22:30 UTC)

emily: Body: "We will perform a brief runtime update in EU on Mar 28 at 22:30 UTC. We pinned redwood-v2-medium for the change. Most requests unaffected; some transient retries possible during canary. Live updates at: https://status.redwood.ai/"

ops_sre: Ops checklist: preflight healthcheck (curl /health -> 200), run long-prompt smoke, snapshot KV cache, monitor p50/p99 and 5xx. Rollback triggers: 5xx >0.7% sustained 2m OR p99 +50% for 3m OR any decode corruption reports.

sam: Add customer note for Dedicated: "Dedicated pools unaffected unless explicitly scheduled."

marta: Support FAQ line added. Please :thumbsup: to schedule.

ops_sre: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary started. Canary pulse (4m): 5xx 0.05%, p99 +7%. No rollback. Proceeding to 25% in 3m.

emily: Statuspage scheduled for 22:10 UTC; email queued to low-priority list at 22:15 UTC.

marta: Live update: moving to 25% rollout. Will hold for 10m.

deploybot: 25% complete. Metrics stable.

ops_sre: Seeing one host with transient fd spike, excluded from next tranche. No customer errors.

marta: Excluded host, continuing. No customer notice required.

deploybot: 100% rollout finished at 23:02 UTC. No rollback triggered.

emily: Final status update posted: maintenance complete, no widespread customer impact.

support-bot: Incident resolved: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2869994321 — resolved at 2026-03-28T23:05:00Z
